_about: The numbers a run is compared with (docs/build-and-test-reference.md). Changes only with the maintainer's approval. Runs are headless, --rtc-seed 1, --max-seconds 600 (or the entry's max_seconds), on the final config. Counts only. The *_vmu runs and the replay run attach a new memory card (a file that doesn't exist yet, so the program makes a blank, formatted one, as a player's first run does); the others attach none. linux_sandbox_speed_x is null where no Linux sandbox has made the run yet. discovery.bytes_total is the span of the emitted functions, not the boot image (3,075,648 bytes): the coverage pass measures against the image.

built_from: dream-recomp 71d5a6639dd2, this repo's pin, built with scripts/10_build_linux.sh on 8 Nov 2026: on top of f8671ad, the windowed launcher drops the cached textures the game writes over in video memory (71d5a66, known bug 41). Headless runs never drop a texture: the four 10-minute runs keep every count, each with the same write hash as at 3023c32, and the gate's three scenarios are identical to f8671ad's, write hash and counters. Before it, f8671ad on top of 3023c32: a return into the middle of a function resumes in the function that has a label there, through any address alias (0204111, known bug 39), and the dev interpreter's log of every address it executes (f8671ad, --exec-coverage, measurement only). Neither changes a count of the four 10-minute runs or of the gate's attract and gameplay scenarios. Before it, 3023c32 on top of d990818: the host's floating-point mode for the runtime's own hooks and the run's end (56a4277, known bug 37; no guest arithmetic changes, the gate identical) and the boot's floating-point mode (3023c32, known bug 36: FPSCR 0x00040000, round to nearest, as the disc's bootstrap hands over, where it was 0x00040001). Bug 36's fix changes the game's arithmetic: the four 10-minute runs keep every count but interrupts and non-zero sound samples, and the maintainer's recording of 5 November no longer replays (known bug 40), so runs.tutorial_mission1_kogane_replay, recorded on 8 November on a build with the fix, replaces it. The translator is 0204111's, which changes only what a function's resume switch matches: discovery gives 12,184 functions, 756,050 instructions, 216 switch tables and 1,263,576 of 1,495,698 bytes, as at every pin since b222a6a. The pin 6c098df gave 12,259 / 712,697 / 120 / 1,216,786 / 1,447,388.
